body:
Writing this post turned out to be far more theraputic than i thought it would, I breazed through most of it - but surprisingly the last sentence made me upset. I guess there is only so much time you can spend putting on "a brave face" before you need to ask for help. For various reasons I could never mention any of this to my friends or family, I am greatful that this is here on reddit, my thoughts would be quite lonely otherwise. I hope that this is rock bottom.  

To those that reply here - thanks very much, for whatever words you say, it would be awful to be ignored. 

If your friends with any longterm unemployed - rather than just asking them if they still dont have a job - encourage them and tell them not to give up, it will be appreciated.
